## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing or maintenance problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented where needed.
- [ ] Security and privacy implications were considered.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are included for visible UI changes.
